title: How much does ac systems repair cost in Business Bay?
desc: The cost is based on the type of issue, the air conditioning system, and any replacement parts required. A professional inspection helps to establish the final repair cost.

title: How many times should AC systems be serviced in Dubai?
desc: Most domestic systems benefit from regular maintenance every three to six months. Commercial units may need more frequent servicing.

title: Can AC cleaning improve cooling performance?
desc: Yes, it can. Cleaning removes dust and blockages that restrict airflow. The AC unit cools more effectively.

title: Why is my AC leaking water?
desc: Well, there are a few reasons, such as blocked drainage lines, frozen coils or a lot of dirt buildup, that can cause AC water leakage.

title: Which air conditioning brands do you collaborate with?

title: How can I improve my AC cooling without calling a technician?
desc:
Follow these steps carefully:
  • Close all windows
  • Clean the filters
  • Keep the unit clear
  • Set the thermostat to a temperature

title: Why does my AC smell bad when I turn it on?
desc: Mold or bacteria inside the AC cause smells. Professional cleaning removes the source completely.

title: What happens if I skip AC servicing for a year?
desc:
• Your AC's efficiency drops
  • Your bills go up
  • Parts wear out faster
  • Small problems become expensive repairs

title: Why does my AC take too long to cool the room?
desc: The filters might be dirty, the gas might be low or the unit might be too small for the room. A technician can check the system and suggest the right solution.

title: Do I need to service my AC before summer starts?
desc: Yes. Servicing before summer prepares your AC for the heavy load ahead. It helps avoid breakdowns when the weather gets extremely hot outside.

title: What should I do if my AC remote stops working?
desc: Check the batteries first. If that does not work, the remote sensor or receiver might be faulty. The AC can still be operated manually until the remote is fixed.
